question: What distant hearing and knowledge are linked to bond and paralysis?
premises: dūra āśravaṇa vijñānaṃ names distant hearing and knowledge
pāśa stobham names bond and paralysis
tathā priye adds likewise, O beloved
inference: Distant hearing and knowledge are linked to bond and paralysis.
plain_english: Distant hearing and knowledge, likewise bond and paralysis, O beloved.
